workflow.name: coveragekeymetrics
workflow.description: Returns legacy-compatible overall coverage, patch coverage, bypass rate, goals, and trend for selected Codecov repositories.

tests.name: Codecov repository returns coverage key metrics
tests.assert_script: if (!output || output.type !== 'stats') throw new Error('expected stats output'); if (!output.data || !output.data.metrics || output.data.metrics.length < 3) throw new Error('missing metrics'); if (output.data.metrics[0].label !== 'Avg Coverage (%)') throw new Error('missing overall coverage');

tests.name: Unknown repository returns a no-data response
tests.assert_script: if (!output || output.error !== 'No code coverage data found for the selected repositories') throw new Error('expected no-data response');

queries.label: coverage_summary
queries.sql_text:
WITH coverage_rows AS (
  SELECT cc.repo_id, cc.commit_sha, MAX(cc.overall_coverage) AS overall_coverage,
    MAX(cc.commit_timestamp) AS commit_timestamp
  FROM _tool_codecov_commit_coverages cc
  WHERE cc.repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
    AND (cc.overall_coverage > 0 OR cc.lines_total > 0)
    AND cc.commit_timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND cc.commit_timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM _tool_codecov_commits cm
      WHERE cm.repo_id = cc.repo_id AND cm.commit_sha = cc.commit_sha
        AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%'
        AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
        AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%'
        AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%'
    )
  GROUP BY cc.repo_id, cc.commit_sha
), ranked AS (
  SELECT repo_id, overall_coverage, commit_timestamp,
    ROUND(AVG(overall_coverage) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id), 2) AS avg_coverage,
    FIRST_VALUE(overall_coverage) OVER (
      PARTITION BY repo_id ORDER BY commit_timestamp ASC, commit_sha ASC
    ) AS earliest_coverage,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY repo_id ORDER BY commit_timestamp DESC, commit_sha DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM coverage_rows
)
SELECT repo_id, ROUND(overall_coverage, 2) AS total_coverage, avg_coverage,
  ROUND(earliest_coverage, 2) AS earliest_coverage,
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(commit_timestamp) * 1000 AS latest_update
FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY repo_id

queries.label: patch_coverage
queries.sql_text:
WITH patch_rows AS (
  SELECT comp.repo_id, comp.commit_sha, comp.flag_name, MAX(comp.patch) AS patch
  FROM _tool_codecov_comparisons comp
  WHERE comp.repo_id IN (:repo_ids) AND comp.patch IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY comp.repo_id, comp.commit_sha, comp.flag_name
)
SELECT p.repo_id, ROUND(AVG(p.patch), 2) AS avg_patch_coverage
FROM patch_rows p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM _tool_codecov_commits cm
  WHERE cm.repo_id = p.repo_id AND cm.commit_sha = p.commit_sha
    AND cm.commit_timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND cm.commit_timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'red-hat-konflux%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'dependabot%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'renovate%'
    AND cm.author NOT LIKE 'snyk-io%'
)
GROUP BY p.repo_id ORDER BY p.repo_id

queries.label: coverage_goals
queries.sql_text:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT rc.repo_id, rc.project_target, rc.project_target_auto,
    rc.project_informational, rc.patch_target, rc.patch_target_auto,
    rc.patch_informational,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rc.repo_id
      ORDER BY rc.updated_at DESC, rc.connection_id DESC) AS row_num
  FROM _tool_codecov_repo_configs rc
  WHERE rc.repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
)
SELECT repo_id, project_target, project_target_auto, project_informational,
  patch_target, patch_target_auto, patch_informational
FROM ranked WHERE row_num = 1 ORDER BY repo_id

queries.label: pr_patch
queries.sql_text:
WITH patch_rows AS (
  SELECT comp.repo_id, comp.commit_sha, comp.flag_name, MAX(comp.patch) AS patch
  FROM _tool_codecov_comparisons comp
  WHERE comp.repo_id IN (:repo_ids) AND comp.patch IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY comp.repo_id, comp.commit_sha, comp.flag_name
), pr_patch AS (
  SELECT p.repo_id, pr.pull_request_key AS pr_number, MAX(pr.url) AS pr_url,
    AVG(p.patch) AS avg_patch
  FROM patch_rows p
  JOIN repos r ON r.name = p.repo_id
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.merge_commit_sha = p.commit_sha
    AND pr.base_repo_id = r.id
  WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED'
    AND pr.merged_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(:from)
    AND pr.merged_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(:to)
  GROUP BY p.repo_id, pr.pull_request_key
), goals AS (
  SELECT repo_id, patch_target FROM (
    SELECT repo_id, patch_target,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id ORDER BY updated_at DESC, connection_id DESC) AS row_num
    FROM _tool_codecov_repo_configs
    WHERE repo_id IN (:repo_ids)
  ) ranked WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT p.repo_id, p.pr_number, p.pr_url, p.avg_patch AS avg_patch,
  COALESCE(g.patch_target, 80) AS effective_threshold
FROM pr_patch p LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.repo_id = p.repo_id
ORDER BY p.repo_id, p.pr_number

queries.label: last_pipeline
queries.sql_text:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(finished_at)) * 1000 AS lastupdate
FROM _devlake_pipelines
WHERE :has_blueprint = 1
  AND blueprint_id IN (:blueprint_ids)
  AND status IN ('TASK_COMPLETED', 'TASK_PARTIAL')
